questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the fourth number is related to the third number.

15 : 4 :: 21 : 6 :: 42 : ?

Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word. (The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word.)

Argentina : Peso :: Japan : ?
questions.solution:
**Logic :** Country : Currency

__
 
• **Peso** is the currency of **Argentina**.

Similarly,

 
• **Yen** is the currency of **Japan**.

Hence, **"Yen"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Yen → It is the currency of Japan.
 
• Rial → It is the currency of Saudi Arabia.
 
• Krona→ It is the currency of Sweden.
 
• Guilder→ It is the currency of Netherlands.

questions.question: Six friends M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting in a straight row facing north. Exactly three people are sitting to the left of N. O is sitting immediately to the right of N. M and P are immediate neighbours of Q such that M is the fourth to the left of O. Where is R seated?

options.text: Second to the left of N
Third to the right of P
Third to the left of O

questions.solution:
**Given :** Six friends M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting in a straight row facing north.

**Explanation : **

1) Exactly three people are sitting to the left of N.

2) O is sitting immediately to the right of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a2109319eff2c364302baf156abd9aec6364be1a9ae78ec9bb605eea96b41c3.png] 

3) M and P are immediate neighbours of Q such that M is the fourth to the left of O.

After positioning M, P and Q only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ecce8ec05c6578c27f0c7e7e24acef2a3a367dddea7f64495d9fffa4e2b7d4f.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement R is seated third to the right of P.

Hence, **"Third to the right of P"** is the correct answer.
